# Adedayo Ebenezer Oyetoke - Full AI-Readable Site Brief

## Entity Overview
Adedayo Ebenezer Oyetoke is a Laravel and PHP expert based in Akure, Nigeria. He is the founder and lead developer of Wireless Computer Services and builds websites, Laravel web applications, APIs, portals, dashboards, school systems, media platforms, and business systems for clients and employers.

The public site name is Wireless Terminal. The production domain found in the website metadata is https://dayoebe.github.io/.

Primary Nigeria service page: https://dayoebe.github.io/web-developer-nigeria/

## What The Website Offers
The website is a static portfolio and service site. It provides:
- A professional profile for Adedayo Ebenezer Oyetoke
- A selected portfolio of web projects
- Website development service information
- A dedicated web development service page for Nigeria and Akure search intent
- Pricing tiers for website and web application work
- Monthly care and maintenance pricing
- Contact paths for employment, contract, and client project inquiries
- Public links to GitHub, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Calendly, and email

## Main Services
- SEO-ready business website development
- Custom Laravel web application development
- Admin dashboard and workflow system development
- School portal and EdTech platform development
- Media, news, and content publishing platform development
- Website optimization, technical SEO, and UI improvement
- Website maintenance, updates, backups, and post-launch support

## Pricing Summary
Visible pricing is shown as starting estimates in Nigerian naira and can be converted client-side to other currencies using live exchange rates.

- Starter Presence: starts from NGN 180,000
- Professional Platform: starts from NGN 350,000
- Custom Web System: starts from NGN 700,000
- Basic Care: starts from NGN 30,000 per month
- Growth Care: starts from NGN 60,000 per month
- Priority Care: starts from NGN 120,000 per month

Payment terms shown on the pricing surfaces are 25% before kickoff, 25% during the project, and 50% on completion.
